thread:
alicia: FYI escalation from Acme Corp (CS-58291). They see intermittent 500s on our /v1/generate endpoint, KMS decrypt errors in their tenant logs, and audit logs missing for certain SSO users. Billing spike reported after they re-ran a batch job. Need triage and a compliance check asap.
 tom_oncall: Can you paste a minimal repro + request id(s)?
 alicia: Customer provided a failing request id: req_0b3f9a2c. They say it happens ~1/10 requests during peak.
 alicia: Repro curl they ran (sanitized):
 ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cus_XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-7b","input":"summarize: long text...","max_tokens":512}'
```
 sana_sre: Saw a similar pattern earlier — 500s with a short-lived upstream KMS 504/DECRYPT_FAIL spike. Can you attach the raw service logs and the tenant-id? Also need the exact timestamp window for the billing spike.
 alicia: Tenant id: tenant-acme-92. Billing spike window: 2025-11-12T14:02:00Z to 2025-11-12T14:18:00Z. I pulled the support logs; attaching excerpt below (customer redacted):
 "[2025-11-12T14:05:03Z] req_0b3f9a2c - srv=runtime - ERROR: kvcache miss; handler returning 500; upstream error: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE key_alias=acme-prod-key"
 victor_sec: @sana_sre important: Acme has data-retention/regulatory requirements. They requested proof of audit logging for deprovisioning events for SSO users. They claim some users who were deprovisioned via SCIM show no audit entries.
 leah_prod: Is this limited to the SCIM deprovision webhook path or full user deletion flows? We need to know whether it's a downstream logging ingestion lag or missing event emission.
 raj_cs: Customer says two users removed on 2025-11-11 18:22:00Z and 18:30:40Z; only one audit entry exists. They flagged this to compliance.
 sana_sre: Action items I propose:
- collect raw runtime logs for tenant-acme-92 from 2025-11-11T18:20:00Z -> 2025-11-12T15:00:00Z
- pull KMS key usage and error metrics for alias acme-prod-key for the billing spike window
- check SCIM sync logs and webhook delivery statuses for those timestamps
 victor_sec: I'll create a compliance packet once we have logs. Also need the encryption key ARN and whether this tenant is on HSM-backed key. If HSM, we may need to engage key provider team.
 alicia: Key alias is acme-prod-key; customer confirmed they use HSM-managed keys via partner-KMS. I've asked them to share the key ARN.
 tom_oncall: Quick mitigation: recommend customer rotate to a fallback model variant and enable retry-with-backoff on their side while we investigate. Also I'll adjust runtime to bypass prefix cache for that tenant briefly to avoid repeated decrypt attempts on hot paths.
 leah_prod: Could be an edge-case with prefix/KV caching + ephemeral KMS throttling — sounds plausible. We'll validate cache invalidation logic for deprovision flows.
 victor_sec: For the missing SCIM audit entries: we should check our event emitter (audit-proxy), and the delivery path to the long-term audit store. If events were dropped due to auth failure against the audit-store (KMS failure?), they'd never appear.
 raj_cs: Customer is getting nervous; compliance deadline in 48 hrs. Can we provide ETA on logs and an interim attestation?
 victor_sec: ETA: 6 hours to collect and validate logs, 24 hours for the compliance packet. Interim: we can provide a signed statement that we are investigating and a list of the internal steps and timestamps. Need POA from legal for regulatory wording.
 sana_sre: I've queued log extract job now. Also adding a trace flag for tenant-acme-92 to increase verbosity for next 2 hours.
 incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20251112-ACME-KMS (priority: high) assigned to tom_oncall, sana_sre, victor_sec
 tom_oncall: I'll take the lead on KMS decryption errors. @victor_sec can you handle compliance packet once logs arrive? @leah_prod please try to repro locally with a simulated HSM throttle.
 leah_prod: Will attempt repro and check our prefix cache invalidation for deprovision. Any sample SCIM payload that triggered missing audit event?
 alicia: Customer posted their SCIM remove payload (redacted):
 ```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"remove","path":"members[value eq \"user:12345\"]"}]}
```
 sana_sre: Noted. Also, getting the request id mapping between SCIM webhook and internal audit event id will help.
 victor_sec: One more ask: get the customer's retention policy and whether they archive audit logs offsite. That affects our analysis.
 raj_cs: I'll ask the customer for the archive location and confirm the two user IDs and timestamps.
 alicia: I'll keep this thread updated. Filing case notes into the ticket: next update in 2 hours or sooner if we get logs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
 tom_oncall: Thanks. If anyone sees repeated 500s spike again, tag me with req ids and I'll rate-limit retries on the edge to reduce downstream KMS load.
 leah_prod: Noted. I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft after containment.
 victor_sec: Adding compliance checklist items: audit integrity checksum, chain of custody for log export, KMS error timeline, SCIM webhook delivery receipts. Will need signatures from infra and legal.
 alicia: Customer asked for a quick mitigation doc we can share. I'll draft and circulate in 30m.
 san_sre: (typo) sana_sre: final note — ensure we don't accidentally surface raw PII from customer logs in the packet. Use redaction tools.
 alicia: Good catch. We'll redact.
 tom_oncall: keeping this open. please update ticket when extracts are uploaded. :thumbsup:
